name: Question 4
problem:
Use the definition of Laplace transforms to calculate $F(s)=L{f(t)},$ where $f(t)$ is given by 

$$
f(t)={\begin{aligned}{e}^{-2t},\, & t\le 3 \\ 1\, & t>3.\end{aligned}
$$

$\,F(s)=L{f(t)}=$ {{field-1}},
valid for {{field-2}}.
